description: This file defines the BodySummarizer class, which implements message body summarization functionality in the Guzzle HTTP client library. It provides a way to generate a summarized version of an HTTP message body, optionally truncating it at a specified length.

classes.name: BodySummarizer
classes.description: A class that summarizes HTTP message bodies, optionally truncating them at a specified length.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the optional truncation length for message summaries.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Returns a summarized version of the provided message's body, using the configured truncation length if set.
